content:
lex: Quick heads-up — CloudPlug partner just confirmed a joint launch window. They want a 45min co-hosted webinar + a benchmark blog that highlights our latency/cost win vs their managed endpoint. Can we sketch a play for comms, assets, and inbound routing?

amy: Awesome. Thanks for flagging. Dates? also need to know which product PM will own the benchmark artifacts.

mike: I can own the benchmark. Will need a test harness, the CloudPlug environment, and a day to run stable med/large seq runs. Prefer week of May 10.

lex: wgtd: CloudPlug prefers May 13 or 15. Webinar target audience: platform engineers evaluating marketplace integrations and infra teams doing cost ops.

jordan: For the webinar flow: 1) 10min market intro w/ CloudPlug rep 2) 15min demo (Redwood + CloudPlug listing + live endpoint) 3) 10min benchmark walkthrough 4) 10min live Q&A. Need slide deck + demo script + benchmark readout.

amy: I'll own comms & registration page. Suggest: landing page with 1) value bullets 2) registration 3) link to tech brief + benchmark appendix. We'll need a short co-auth blog to publish same week.

sana: For inbound routing — propose: marketplace leads -> sales-seg 'marketplace-inquiry' queue; webinar registrants -> SDR nurture for 2 weeks then route to AE if MQL. I can set the Zap/segment rules. Need the tracking params and UTM map.

mike: Benchmark plan: run 3 models (open Llama variant, 7B quant, 13B fp16) across 3 seq lengths (256/1024/2048) on our hosted and CloudPlug managed instance. Collect p50/p95 latency and tokens-per-dollar. I'll produce a CSV + charts. Can we get access to their env creds?

lex: Yes, CloudPlug will share test creds — asking for ephemeral key with rate limit. Also they want a short coauth blurb from Redwood (1-2 paras) and a small customer quote if possible.

amy: Copy for comms: I'll draft headline + bullets. Need 2-3 visuals: benchmark chart, architecture diagram, hero screenshot of marketplace listing. Jordan — can you capture the listing screenshot?

jordan: Yep. I'll make a quick architecture SVG and take screenshots on Tuesday. Also drafting demo CLI steps:
```
# run local smoke against hosted endpoint
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"hello"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY'
```

sana: Routing sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Xyz-marketplace-routing — I've added a 'field mapping' tab. Please add required lead fields (company, infra-type, region, size).

amy: Timeline proposal:
- Draft comms + registration by Apr 25
- Benchmarks done by May 4
- Slides & demo by May 8
- Rehearsal May 11
- Webinar May 13 (preferred)
Coauth blog publish May 14.

mike: Sounds good. I'll prioritize benchmark runs next week.

lex: Ops-bot: please create calendar event and link the runbook in the invite.

ops-bot: Created event "CloudPlug x Redwood: Co-launch webinar" on 2025-05-13 16:00 UTC. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/cloudplug-co-launch. Invite: https://calendar.link/abc123 :white_check_mark:

amy: I'll ping design for three visuals. Also need short speaker bios from Mike and CloudPlug rep by EOD Wed.

jordan: Adding demo script to the runbook now. Small ask: can product expose a short latency endpoint for demo (no auth) or should we use a pre-signed token?

mike: We'll issue a short-lived pre-signed demo token and post it to runbook.

lex: Nice — moving to execution. Any blockers?

sana: No blockers from routing side. I will set initial automation and capture test leads during the webinar.

amy: Great. I'll follow up with a first draft of landing + email copy by tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
